Common.tagline: A little place for big conversations.

Landing.intro: Anyone can join with a verified email address. Your space starts private, even without friends. Connect only when you choose.

Auth.description: Sign in or create an account with your verified email. You can join without any invitation.
Auth.unavailable: Sign-in will be available once Clerk and Convex are configured.

Home.description: A little corner to feel at home. Set things up your way, bring in your favorite people, and take your time.
Home.nextStepsDescription: Just two easy things to start with.

Connections.description: Your people, your pace. No public directory, no random requests — just the friends you choose.
Connections.contactsCaption: A quiet place for your favorite people

Invites.emailRestriction: An invitation without an email restriction can be used by the first eligible person who accepts it.

Profile.title: Profile & privacy
Profile.identityDescription: Customize how friends and family see you in shared spaces.
Profile.statusPlaceholder: Listening to rainy lo-fi and roasting chestnuts…
Profile.reducedMotion: Prefer reduced motion (calm companion and interface animations)
Profile.handleHelp: Handle must be 3–24 characters using lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores.
Profile.accentHelp: Accent color must use a valid hex value.
Profile.presenceDescription: All signals are enabled by default for a warm shared space, and each can be toggled off independently at any time.
Profile.onlineDescription: Show when you are actively connected to Sengapp.
Profile.lastSeenDescription: Allow friends to see when you last visited the lounge.
Profile.readReceiptsDescription: Show when you have read messages in direct and group chats.
Profile.typingDescription: Display a live indicator when you are composing a reply.

Operator.title: Operator tools
Operator.roles: Account roles are controlled by the verified server-side allowlist. Member signup never grants operator privileges.
